answer: A Sybil swarm is like shale: cheap layers that split apart under pressure. Resist it by requiring each identity to finish a sequential, non-parallelizable proof-of-work puzzle every epoch. A raven cannot be in two places at once, and one machine cannot solve a thousand serial puzzles at once, so fakes cost real time instead of cheap copies. New identities also start with lotus-thin standing: they may work, but cannot vote until established peers attest real completed jobs.
